description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Kandivli, along with the Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-E-Punjab, Rotary Club of Ghatkopar West, and Rotary Club of Boisar Tarapur, proudly joined hands for a Free Medical Camp at Deherje Village, Vikramgad, Palghar on 23rd October 2026.

🤝 With the valuable support of Aastha Hospital, Manor, and Adhikari Lifeline Hospital, Boisar, this collaborative initiative brought essential healthcare services closer to the community.
Rotary Club of Bombay Kandivli with support from Rtn Dr Avinash Sonawane and his team of Aastha Hospital- Manor; successfully provided specialist medical services in the form of A Gynaecologist, A Pediatrician and A General Physician along with total 10 nursing and support staff for this medical camp. *Over 130 patients were screened and guided for further treatment which includes 10 cataract patients requiring surgery.
